comment: The chronological plan's curated order (READING-PLANS.md decision #4) —
data/chronological.json. Edit here, rebuild with `npm run pack:data`
Era-ordering at book granularity, the classic arrangement: Job inside the
patriarch narrative (Genesis split around it); David's psalms after his
story; Solomon's wisdom books after his; the prophets between the books of
the kings by ministry era, Obadiah with the fall of Jerusalem; Chronicles
as the exile-era retrospective whose closing decree Ezra continues; the
epistles after Acts in composition order. Entries are a book id (whole
book) or [book, firstChapter, lastChapter]; the builder verifies the
expansion covers every canon chapter exactly once, so a typo here fails
the build instead of shipping a plan with a hole in it.
